name: Nam Securities Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, NAM Securities Ltd is in 
 the business of Securities Trading & brokerage[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview[1][2]
Company is a SEBI-registered Member of 
NSE, BSE, DSE, MCX-SX & NSDL dealing
 in Cash, the business of Broking, distribution of financial products, Depository Participant with NSDL, Advisory Services, Clearing & Depository, etc.
Services Offered
a) Equity[3]
b) Derivatives[4]
c) Investment Advisory[5]
d) Currency[6]
e) Mutual Funds[7]
f) Depository[8]

cons: Stock is trading at 4.27 times its book value
Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.56% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of 2.21% over last 3 years.
